We also have Amazon's best-quality refurbished iPhone 17 Pro drops up to $220, fleeting summer Apple Watch Series 11 deals starting from $299, and one of the all-time lowest prices on Amazon's latest Nitro Black Beats 240W braided USB-C cable at $18 (60% off). Most affordable 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air drops $200 today, more deals

The AirPods Pro 3 price drops continue this summer, and we also have $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, but M5 MacBook Air discounts have been relatively rare over the past month or so. We started seeing $100 markdowns on Amazon to ease the price increase pressure, but we just spotted a notable $200 discount at B&H on this 24GB model that Amazon doesn't carry.

Amazon is currently offering $100 off multiple 13-inch and 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configurations:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,199 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,399 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,899 (originally $1,999)

As noted above, Amazon doesn't carry the official 24GB/1TB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configuration — this is the most affordable 24GB model you can buy. However, Apple authorized reseller B&H has it, currently selling for $200 below MSRP:

B&H is selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,499 with free shipping. Originally priced at $1,699, it's now $200 off.

This is one of the best M5 MacBook Air deals we've tracked since the official price increase.

If you're after a MacBook Pro, we have configurations this week that are $400 and $500 below list price, and not limited to the highest-end models:

Grab the M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB at $500 off, 48GB models $400 off, more deals

In addition to the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 during 'Black Friday in July', and $100 off all colors of the Apple AirPods Max 2, we're still seeing notable price-increase-easing deals on the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup. Highlights include a $500 discount on the 24GB/2TB 14-inch M5 Pro model from Amazon, and $400 off the 48GB model at B&H.

This is hands down the best M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal we've tracked since the price hike, with Amazon selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $2,499 with free shipping. Originally $2,999, this configuration with 24GB RAM and 2TB built-in storage is now $500 off the new pricing.

This deal is particularly appealing because Apple just raised the price of this configuration by $400, and prior to that, the price on Amazon had never dropped below $2,340.

Another highlight of this week's MacBook Pro deals is B&H offering the 48GB/1TB 14-inch M5 Pro model for $2,799 with free shipping. You naturally have to pay more for double the RAM here, but this is also $400 off the $3,199 MSRP, and it's a configuration Amazon doesn't carry at all.

The remaining MacBook Pro deals we've tracked this week are as follows:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $2,019)
  • Comes with a free Apple 96W USB-C power adapter (worth $20)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (originally $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,049 (originally $2,199)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,199 (originally $2,519)
  • Includes upgraded 96W Apple charger (worth $20)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,299 (originally $2,499)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (originally $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (originally $4,399)

The most affordable M5 Max MacBook Pro you can buy is now $500 off on Amazon

Amazon's best-quality refurbished iPhone 17 Pro drops $220, iPhone 17 Pro Max up to $450

If you want to pick up a current-generation iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max at a discount, there are some options this week. Deals on brand-new unlocked models from reputable channels are hard to come by, but we're still tracking up to $220 off Amazon's best-quality refurbished 17 Pro, and Woot has once again launched 17 Pro Max deals with up to $450 off.

Over at Amazon, you can once again find up to $220 off 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models — these are Amazon Renewed Premium units, backed by a one-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and 'over 90% original battery life.' Standard Amazon refurbished units only come with a 90-day warranty and don't have the same battery guarantee.

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (originally new $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (originally new $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (originally new $1,299)

However, over at Woot, the larger 17 Pro Max deals are still hot on 'new' condition (i.e., 'never landed in a customer's hands') units. You can enjoy up to $450 off Apple pricing here, but color options are starting to dwindle:

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (originally $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (originally $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (originally $1,999)

Apple Watch Series 11 summer deals starting to disappear, grab the most popular models while they're still $100 off

While we're still tracking the $50 summer discount on AirPods Pro 3, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and the historical low price on the four-pack Apple AirTag 2, the discounts on the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 are starting to disappear. If you want to upgrade your Apple wearable with a $100 discount, you'll need to act fast.

Amazon is currently selling the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $299, and the 46mm model for $329 with free shipping. That's $100 below the $399 and $429 original prices for your most affordable models respectively.

However, color options for these deals are now starting to disappear. A few colors are still available at the discounted price, but it seems these Series 11 summer discounts are starting to sell out or return to full price from this week onward.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) now as low as $119 on Amazon, more models starting from $99

The summer markdowns and 'Black Friday in July' deals on the current-generation AirPods lineup continue this week. We're still tracking $50 off the AirPods Pro 3 from MSRP, and $100 off all colors of the AirPods Max 2. However, we're also tracking the best price on the AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) in months, with Amazon Renewed Premium units as low as $119.

Amazon is selling the Apple AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) for $144.99 with free shipping. Originally $179, it's now 20% off MSRP, and the best deal we've seen since March.

Don't forget you can also pick up the Amazon Renewed Premium version for $119 now — this is an Amazon Renewed Premium unit, backed by a one-year warranty promise, offering Amazon's best refurbished quality.

For some folks, unless you specifically want the AirPods 4 form factor, paying $55 more for the AirPods Pro 3 while it's on sale would be the better call, but we're still tracking notable markdowns on any model you want.
